decision.explanation: The query 'What is the location of Abingdon High School?' matches three distinct valid entities found in the source documents: 1) 'Abingdon-Avon High School' located in Abingdon, Illinois (D1S1); 2) 'Abingdon High School (Virginia)' located in Abingdon, Virginia (D2S1); and 3) 'Abingdon School' located in Abingdon, Oxfordshire, England (D3S1). The instruction explicitly states that distinct valid namesakes and complementary answers may coexist and that different people/entities can have distinct locations. All three answers are directly supported by the text and represent different referents, so they are all included.
